c: Satin a 50 g piece of warm sugar (see Pulled Sugar); form a hollow ball around the warm pump nozzle.
Inflate gently with the pump while rotating; shape with the palm; cool with a fan while maintaining slight pressure.
Detach by heating the neck with a small flame; airbrush with cocoa-butter-free colour or dust.
Use within 48 h in a humidity-controlled room.

c: Cook isomalt to 165 °C; brush or spray baking paper lightly with vodka (or alcohol spray).
Pour a thin stream over the crumpled paper; lift and tilt so it spreads into bubbles; cool.
Break into shards; add colour or lustre dust; store dry.
Pipe 160 °C isomalt from a paper cone onto silicone in lace patterns; cool and lift.
0d90de88.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). 1 week.

c: Cook to light amber (165 °C); stop on cold water; cool to a thick honey thread.
Cages: lightly oil the back of a ladle; drizzle in a lattice; rim; cool 1 min; twist off.
Spirals: wrap threads around an oiled steel rod; slide off. Shards: pour thin on silicone; break.
Add sesame or nibs before setting for texture; assemble within 2 h.
dd15abc1.st: Make on the day; 2 h open, 24 h airtight with silica gel.
dd15abc1.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. No major allergens.

c: Spread tempered chocolate thinly on a marble or steel sheet; leave until it just loses its gloss (stripes of white chocolate first for zebra).
Cigarettes: push a triangular scraper at 45° to roll tight cylinders; cut ends with a warm knife.
Copeaux: shave with a ring cutter or palette across the sheet into large curls.
Lift with a cold palette; store in a box at 16–18 °C.
7f3170f9.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation).

c: Leaves: wash and dry non-toxic leaves (rose, bay); brush the underside with tempered chocolate; set; peel.
Feathers: dip a palette tip in chocolate, press onto acetate and drag; comb with a fork; curve on a rolling pin.
Lace: pipe fine lattices from a paper cornet onto acetate; set on a curve.
f2aa23ad.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation).

c: Cast a 2 cm base in a frame on acetate; discs and plaques 5 mm; tubes in acetate rolls; spheres from moulds.
Crystallise all pieces 12 h at 16 °C before assembly.
Glue with tempered chocolate, joint fixed with cold spray; build from heavy base up keeping the centre of gravity low.
Finish with velvet spray, cocoa-butter splatter and gold leaf; display ≤ 22 °C away from sun and spotlights.
Apply gold leaf with a dry brush; dust lustre lightly.
2d14c9d7.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). Display 1–2 weeks.

c: Polish moulds with cotton wool; optionally brush coloured cocoa butter at 29 °C first.
Fill with tempered chocolate; tap; invert to drain; scrape clean; set at 16 °C 15 min; second coat if hollow showpiece.
Unmould after 1 h at 12–15 °C when they release from the mould.
Seal halves by touching their rims on a warm plate (45 °C) and joining; or fill with mousse/fruit before sealing.
4f79159d.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation).
4f79159d.al: 6 Soybeans (dark couverture 56%) · 7 Milk (dark couverture 56%). May contain milk, soy, nuts (traces).

c: Melt cocoa butter and chocolate to 40 °C; blend; strain.
Fill a warm spray gun (pistolet); spray at 35–40 °C onto entremets frozen to −20 °C from 30–40 cm.
Velvet forms instantly; defrost the entremet in the fridge; white velvet: white chocolate + cocoa butter 50 : 50 + white colour.
797c7089.st: Store velvet mix at room temperature (never chilled); re-melt to 40 °C; keeps 6 months.
797c7089.al: 6 Soybeans (dark couverture 56%) · 7 Milk (dark couverture 56%). May contain milk, soy, nuts (traces).

c: Melt cocoa butter to 40 °C; blend in fat-soluble colour powders with a stick blender; strain.
Temper by cooling to 27 °C and rewarming to 29–30 °C (or seed with 1% cocoa butter powder).
Splatter, brush or stencil the tempered colour onto acetate or guitar sheets; set 10 min.
Spread tempered chocolate over; cut shapes when semi-set; turn over under a weight; peel acetate after 12 h at 16 °C.

c: Use only food-grade, pesticide-free flowers; trim stems; clean with a dry brush.
Paint each petal thinly with lightly beaten egg white; sprinkle fine sugar all over; shake off excess.
Dry on a rack at room temperature 12–24 h (or 50 °C dehydrator 2 h) until crisp.
c00761f6.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). 2 weeks.

c: Room 18–20 °C, RH < 50%; dehumidifier on during sugar work; chocolate room 18–20 °C.
Thermometers calibrated weekly; sugar lamp, spirit lamp, heat gloves, silicone mats, pump, cold spray, silica gel kept in a dedicated box.
Burns: cool under running water 20 min; iced-water bowl at every sugar station; never two people pulling sugar at one lamp.
Display-only pieces (wires, non-food supports, sprays) labelled 'NOT FOR CONSUMPTION'; no wires inserted directly into cakes (use posy picks).
Edible décor labelled with allergens: eggs (royal icing, gum paste), milk (milk/white chocolate), nuts (nougatine, pralines), soy (lecithin).
Gold leaf and lustre: only food-grade, EU-approved (E175 gold); non-toxic craft dusts never on food.
6774c82a.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Reference card.

c: Beat egg whites with ⅔ of the sugar to soft royal icing; add tylose and mix until it thickens.
Knead in remaining sugar and melted cocoa butter to a smooth, elastic paste; wrap airtight; rest 24 h.
Roll 0.5–1 mm; cut petals; thin edges with a ball tool on a foam pad; vein and cup.
Rose: cone centre on wire dried 24 h, then 3-5-7 petal rounds; dry each stage; dust with colour and steam briefly.
7c1ee8e1.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). Paste 3 months airtight; dried flowers 6 months.

c: Roast at 160 °C 10 min; skin; push a cocktail stick into each nut.
Cook to 165 °C; cool until thick; dip each nut and hang upside down from a shelf edge over paper so a long thread drips and sets.
Trim the tail to length with scissors; remove sticks.
bb87a699.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). 24 h.

c: Melt isomalt with water over medium heat; skim; cook to 170 °C without stirring.
Add colour at 160 °C; stop the cooking at 170 °C by dipping the pan base in cold water 5 s.
Pour 150 g pucks on a silicone mat; cool; store with silica gel.
Re-melt pucks in a microwave (30 s bursts) or under a sugar lamp to 85–90 °C (pulling temperature).
9ff89112.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). Pucks keep 6 months.

c: Warm almonds at 120 °C; cook sugar and glucose to a light caramel (165 °C); add butter and hot almonds; mix.
Pour on silicone; roll between two mats to 2 mm while warm.
Cut with an oiled knife or cutters; shape over cones/moulds; reheat in a 160 °C oven to soften.
74605089.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). 1 week.

c: Soak gelatine in the water; melt at 40 °C; add lemon.
Mix into sifted sugar and starch; knead quickly to a firm, smooth paste; keep covered (it dries in minutes).
Roll 3–5 mm on starch; cut with templates; dry flat 24–48 h, turning once.
Sand edges smooth; assemble with royal icing; paint with food colour or airbrush.
7a21f13d.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). Dried pieces 6 months.
7a21f13d.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. No major allergens.

c: Set frames on a silicone mat; oil the metal edges lightly.
Cook isomalt to 165 °C; colour; rest 2 min to release bubbles; pour 1 cm thick in one go; prick bubbles with a hot pin.
Marble effect: drop colours in and swirl once with a skewer.
Unmould when warm but set (10–15 min); cool flat; assemble pieces with hot sugar glue, chilled with a cold spray at the joint.
7f220a45.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). Showpiece life 1–2 weeks in a dry room.

c: Bring the cooked mass (see Isomalt Base) to 85–90 °C on a silicone mat; fold edges in until it holds shape.
Pull and fold 20–30 times until it turns satin and silky (air bubbles trapped = shine); keep under the sugar lamp.
Ribbon: join 3 colour strips, pull to length, fold and pull again; cut warm with scissors.
Rose: pull a thin petal edge from the mass, cup with the thumb, attach around a cone centre; 9–12 petals.
Assemble with a spirit-lamp-heated joint; display within 24 h in a dry room.

c: Beat egg whites with sugar and lemon on low speed 8–10 min to stiff peak (dull, holds a point).
Line work: soft peak (add water 1 tsp at a time) · flood: 10-second consistency · stencil: stiff.
Pipe lattices and lace on acetate; run-outs on a template under acetate; dry 24 h at room temperature.
Keep covered with a damp cloth; re-beat before use.
399cf0dc.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). Icing 0–3 °C 5 days covered; dried décor 3 months.

c: Cook to 155 °C (hard crack); dip the pan base in cold water; cool 1–2 min until the syrup threads.
Dip a cut whisk or two forks and flick over two oiled steel bars 40 cm apart.
Gather the threads into nests or wrap around a ring for halos; serve within 30 min (humidity collapses it).
002ab9fa.st: Make to order; holds 30 min (2 h with silica gel in a closed box).
002ab9fa.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. No major allergens.

c: Line a deep box with foil.
Cook sugar and water to 138 °C; colour; off the heat stir in royal icing quickly: the mass foams and rises.
Return to the heat 5 s; pour immediately into the box; cool 1 h; break into rocks.
fcc9eed5.st: Store airtight with silica gel at 16–18 °C, RH < 50%; never refrigerate sugar or chocolate décor (condensation). 1 month.

c: boil 1 kg sugar + 300 g water + 200 g glucose
Dissolve before boiling; wash crystals down the sides with a wet brush; never stir after boiling.
Thread 106–112 °C (syrups) · soft ball 112–116 °C (fudge, Italian meringue 118–121 °C) · firm ball 118–120 °C (caramels).
Hard ball 121–130 °C (nougat, marshmallow) · soft crack 132–143 °C (toffee) · hard crack 146–155 °C (pulled, poured, spun sugar).
Light caramel 160–170 °C · dark caramel 175–180 °C; stop cooking by dipping the pan base in cold water.
Calibrate the thermometer in boiling water each week (100 °C at sea level, ≈ 96 °C at 1,000 m altitude: subtract the difference).
ff3debd0.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Reference card.

c: Pour ⅔ on a clean, dry marble; work with spatula and scraper until it thickens slightly (27–28 °C dark, 26–27 °C milk, 25–26 °C white).
Return to the remaining ⅓ and mix to working temperature: dark 31–32 °C, milk 29–30 °C, white 28–29 °C.
Test: a knife tip set in 3–5 min at 20 °C, glossy and snapping = tempered.
Add 1% Mycryo-type cocoa butter powder at 34–35 °C to melted chocolate; mix and use at working temperature.
